name: readme-reviewer
description: Craft-first quality review for GitHub READMEs — an LLM judges how well it is written; lint only filters hygiene and security

plugins.name: readme-reviewer
plugins.description: Review any GitHub README for how well it is WRITTEN. The primary judgment is an LLM craft review across five dimensions (R-001~R-005) — first-screen positioning, shortest runnable path, writing quality, honest limits, and support & maintenance; a deterministic lint runs first as a hygiene/security filter and its output is explicitly not a quality verdict. Shape-aware: library, CLI, app, research, awesome list, monorepo and template READMEs get different exemptions. Evidence is triangulation (public specs + qualitative patterns), NOT a star gradient.
